title: MAPIM and 30-plus NGO memorandum gathering outside the Swedish Embassy
reason: The opened Sinar Harian report describes about 100 people from more than 30 NGOs objecting to Swedish handling of a Quran burning, delivering a memorandum to the Swedish Embassy, and discussing a possible boycott of Swedish products. It does not report a request that Malaysia’s government change policy; the action’s recorded target is Sweden, a foreign state.
notes: Kept separate from the HTM morning sequence and PAS Youth/PN after-prayers rally: distinct organizers and reported memorandum activity. Political affiliations of individuals/NGO members alone do not supply a Malaysia state target. S007 is likely Bernama-origin republication and S008 photo captions; neither is counted as independent confirmation.
